policy: Load only routes whose trigger is true; simple questions load none.

routes.requirement: Confirm authority, scope, protected state and smallest sufficient change.

routes.trigger: Observed bug, runtime error, failed check or integration problem
routes.requirement: Use decisive local evidence; do not manufacture a failure.

routes.trigger: Durable schema, dependency, external integration or orchestration decision
routes.requirement: Check consumers, reversibility, security and final verification.

routes.trigger: Significant UI behavior or layout change
routes.requirement: Use the existing visual verifier on affected routes only.

routes.trigger: Validated multi-lot execution or long resume
routes.requirement: Execute the bounded pass without micro-gates while scope remains stable.

routes.trigger: Target files are unknown or PROJECT_PROFILE knowledge.mode is nexus_kg
routes.requirement: Use RepoMap only when navigation is needed; use MCP only under MCP_POLICY.yaml.

routes.trigger: Continuity is useful for a non-trivial task
routes.requirement: Maintain one compact task_state.yaml; read legacy contracts only when present.

routes.trigger: Final result is ready to prove
routes.requirement: Choose the least expensive final evidence that covers the risk.

routes.trigger: Build, restart, deploy or runtime activation explicitly requested
routes.requirement: Protect the active runtime and one rollback; distinguish every proof layer.

routes.trigger: Context handoff, compaction or significant interruption
routes.requirement: Load the compact open state and unresolved evidence only.
